verdict.rationale: Notion's REST API covers broad workspace surface area. The docs say you can read, create, and update "nearly everything" (pages, databases, users, comments), and this is backed by a published OpenAPI spec, webhooks, Agent session/management APIs, and an official MCP server for read/create/update. However, the vendor's own wording ("nearly everything") concedes the API does not match the UI, and no evidence enumerates which UI features are missing. missing for 10: documented full UI-API parity (or an explicit gap list), evidence of delete/admin/workspace-settings operations via API, independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
